intro.data: A natural transformation turns one functor into another, one object at a time. safeHead turns a List into an Optional — its first element, if any. Choose the safeHead component at each object.
intro.alchemy: A natural transformation turns one functor into another, one material at a time. Sample turns a Batch into a Trace — one piece, if any. Choose the Sample component at each material.
intro.spellcraft: A natural transformation turns one functor into another, one essence at a time. Catch turns a Swarm into an Echo — one member, if any. Choose the Catch component at each essence.
intro.abstract: A natural transformation α : F ⇒ G gives a component α_A : F(A) → G(A) at every object. Choose the component at each object.

goal.data: At each object, draw to the safeHead component F(A) → G(A).
goal.alchemy: At each material, draw to the Sample component F(A) → G(A).
goal.spellcraft: At each essence, draw to the Catch component F(A) → G(A).
goal.abstract: At each object, choose the component α_A : F(A) → G(A).

afterSuccess.data: You chose a component at every object — together they form safeHead, a natural transformation from List to Optional. One arrow per object, all at once.
afterSuccess.alchemy: You chose a component at every material — together they form Sample, a natural transformation from Batch to Trace.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: You chose a component at every essence — together they form Catch, a natural transformation from Swarm to Echo.
afterSuccess.abstract: You chose a component at every object — together they form a natural transformation α : F ⇒ G.

reveal.summary: A natural transformation α : F ⇒ G is a family of components α_A : F(A) → G(A), one for every object A — a single arrow between two functors.
reveal.moreFormal: The components must satisfy the naturality condition (next puzzle). Natural transformations are the morphisms of the functor category [C, D]; functors are its objects.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: safeHead<A>: List<A> => Optional<A> — one polymorphic function, all types at once.
